name: Casa Silva
about: Casa Silva is a family winery at the Angostura estate near San Fernando, in the Colchagua Valley. The family's wine story begins in 1887, when Emilio Bouchon arrived from near Saint-Emilion in Bordeaux to work as an oenologist in Chile. In 1978 Mario Silva Cifuentes began recovering the old Bouchon vineyards and cellar and sold wine in bulk.

The Casa Silva brand started bottling in April 1997, and the winery counts that as its beginning. It now has vineyards in Los Lingues, Angostura, Lolol and Paredones, and a project far to the south at Lago Ranco.
